not_found.searched: The 2025 Civics Test page links only the question list and the study guide. The Study for the Test index lists "Interactive Practice Tests" as a type of resource, but no practice test for the 2025 version was found on either page.

There is no separate list of sample interview questions for civics: the test is itself asked aloud at the interview, and the 128-question list is what the officer asks from. USCIS also publishes English reading and writing vocabulary lists for the English test, noted under the Study for the Test page.
